epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 屠浮宮是東廠專門結交黨羽的朝庭禁地。大太監劉瑾為了得到大明藏寶圖,想借鑒賞寶物大會之名除掉與他不和的錦衣衛,卻被江湖人稱“盜聖一枝梅的沈鳶打亂。但沈鳶卻不幸受困,得到錦衣衛副指揮使周慕鋒的幫助脫險。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eunuch Liu plots to eliminate a rival imperial guard and seize a valuable treasure map. However, his plot is foiled by Thief Heroine, who is captured but later rescued by a deputy commander. The truth eventually reveals itself that it is all part of a conspiracy to unveil the secret of the Ming Dynastys hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某朝年間,齊王殺兄長靈宗奪位,天下動盪。此時忠威鏢局負責護送一張神秘藏寶圖到杭州府,用以資助鎮南將軍起兵復辟,及幫助靈宗的舊太子“花月明重掌江山社稷。而崑崙派掌門高照受命於齊王,負責剿滅餘黨及安排奪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Qi kills his brother and seizes the throne, causing chaos in the country. When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了取長補短,陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間,陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起,為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴,他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演,比武場上陳真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球太空基地捕捉到一組來自外太空的神秘訊號,為探尋外星文明,艦長“原帶領船員駕駛著星際探索飛船“深空號駛向宇宙,但不久飛船卻神秘失蹤。150年後,深空號突然出現,船上只剩下一名女科學家“尹。在她..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Yuan and his crew explore the mysteries of outer space after the Space Centre detects extraterrestrial signals. However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 霍元甲年少氣盛,認為武術為重。為了在天津的武館立足,他連續打敗了七家武館,在對戰大刀王五的徒弟幽蘭時,卻遭到朝廷勢力袁庭山的陷害。與此同時,霍負責護送維新首領譚先生回京城。在這次驚心動魄的任務中,他逐..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Huo Yuan Jia loves marital arts. He defeats seven martial arts school masters to establish himself in Tianjin, but is set up by a court official during a tournament. When Huo escorts a revolutionary leader to the capital, he finally understands that the country and its people are the ultimate purpose for practising martial arts.

epg.programme_title_en: The Thousand Faces of Fei Jia
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王小俠本是一個胸無大志,在市井街頭討生活的小鎮青年,與父親老瞎子生活在十隱鎮,唯一的願望就是能治好父親的眼疾。一次偶然令王小俠邂逅了沈藍兒,並意外地捲入了一場陰謀之中。而王小俠為了找能治好父親的眼疾方..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his fathers eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,陰陽鎮遭恐怖詛咒,傳說進去後誰也出不去,離開的人都會神秘死亡。尋寶人閻陽一和寶葫蘆誤入了陰陽鎮,雖然閻不相信傳說,但他在鎮上卻常常遇到可怕的事情。然而讓閻和寶更沒想到的是,在詛咒之下的詭異小..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yin Yang Town has been cursed during the Republican period and legend has it that anyone who leaves the town will be mysteriously killed. Two treasure hunters who do not believe the legend inadvertently enter the town and experience horrifying events. The real surprise lies in an astonishing secret in this cursed town...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在東北下鄉的知識青年胡八一等人為了救助患病的村民畫眉,聯合獵人趙叔前去森林雪人熊洞採集解藥。然而,一夥人突然遭到熊的攻擊,只好逃入黃鼠狼地下洞穴。他們目睹了那裡發生的奇怪事情和出現幻覺。胡等人破除迷信..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Hu Ba and hunter Zhao venture to a bear-guarded cave to find an antidote to cure a sick villager. Attacked by the bear, they take refuge in a weasels cave where they encounter bizarre incidents and illusions. After Hu and Zhao dispelled the superstition trap and uncovered the true culprit, they successfully escape and rescue the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青,另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件,二人組成了臨時搭檔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Zhou dynasty, two girls living in two ends of the Luo He River come from diverse backgrounds - one is a captains daughter and another is a common swindler - and they encounter a series of mysterious events in Luo Yang City. Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學狂人私下研發了一種具有交感神經、高度發達的人形機器人。偶然地,機器人獲得了獨立意識,更通過黑科技手段換取了貌美女子蘇辛的皮膚及軀殼,接近蘇的男友王升。另外,不斷有離奇殺人案發生,引起了警員李洞賓的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十世紀90年代末的哈爾濱,于鐵在替人收債時,對借貸人的女兒金佳麗一見鍾情。鐵雖然是收債人,但他為人講義氣、心地善良及認真對待感情的態度,終於打動了麗。可惜鐵突如其來的頭痛,加上與收債組織的大哥在處事..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the late 90s in Harbin, Tie falls for Li while collecting debts from her father. Li is touched by Ties loyalty, kindness and desire for true love. Unfortunately, a sudden headache hits Tie and he gets into an argument with the boss of the debt collection agency, putting more strain on the relationship of the two lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國際刑警鐵嘉文痛失愛人後隱姓埋名成為了健身房老闆娘。她帶領著男神教練孟京、瑜伽教練喜喜和拳擊教練東妮,本想安然度日,然而舊日仇怨和黑勢力仍不放過鐵。一場針對鐵和其姐妹的狩獵遊戲正悄然展開,鐵決意替姐妹..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Interpol officer Tie Jia Wen mourns the loss of her lover, and lives incognito as a gym owner with her coaches, Meng Jing, Xi Xi and Dong Ni. However, Tie is troubled by her past when vengeful triad gangs come after her and her coaches. Vowing to uphold justice, Tie decides to fight against the evil gangsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少林習武歸來的方世玉,本打算過平常人的生活,但剛回到家鄉肇慶便牽扯到一樁貪腐案中。朝廷貪官的爪牙鄂爾多帶隊殺人滅口並企圖銷毀證據,方世玉雖面對好友周蓉的慘死,母親被擒為人質,但卻面無懼色,決意反抗到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having mastered the Shaolin martial arts, Fang Shi Yu yearns for a tranquil existence back home but becomes entangled in a corruption scandal. The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國,加入了殺手組織都司府,成為十二暗軍的預備役,專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技,在查案時邂逅秋葵,兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死,最終葛..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大陳天啟年間,發生了西域舞姬控物懸浮事件,負責靈異怪事的部門“夜行司派出陳淩前往無相城調查。城內叛徒木道人假意幫陳,其實想奪走城內的異能植物日輪花,讓大陳百姓感染花毒癲狂噬人,以報服大陳和無相城..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇門派和五毒派為江湖兩大門派,而這兩大派為了“皇家龍種花落誰家而各施各法,奇門派誤打誤撞中揭穿了皇叔試圖阻止皇帝有子嗣的陰謀。皇叔派五毒派弟子秀明試圖毒害皇太子,而奇門則派出多美。多美為人善良,且鍾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期,志願軍三排排長孟大關臨危受命,帶領小隊前去解救被困敵後的偵察排。經歷了一系列艱難險阻,孟與由杜川帶領的偵察排終於成功匯合。為了避免部隊有更大傷亡,孟與杜在危急關頭果斷決定,要困死那個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天后武則天壽宴之際,房州城發生“赤目怪物傷人事件。狄仁傑奉命與不良人沈青青及徒弟陳江橋結成探案分隊前往調查,而所有證據似乎都表明幕後主謀正是被廢太子李顯,但狄卻敏銳地發現真相絕非如此簡單,背後蘊藏著..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wus birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 普通青年朗俊在一次送貨過程中意外受傷,卻成了黑暗勢力“三羽聯的實驗品。他被變為半狼人,擁有了超能力。在成功逃走後,朗得躲避“三羽聯的追殺,在過程中他偶然發現了父親死亡的真相。為了尋找身體變異的原因..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lang Jun is injured during a delivery and subsequently becomes a guinea pig in a gangs lab experiment, transforming into a super powered werewolf. After his escape, Lang uncovers the truth behind his fathers death, and must fight against the gangsters to unravel the cause of his mutation and protect his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少男曾為獲得格鬥冠軍的哥哥少北為驕傲,以為有哥哥在便能永遠保護自己,可以像少年時一樣無憂無慮。最終哥哥在衝刺世界格鬥冠軍擂臺上身受重傷意外身亡。格鬥公司創辦人丹姐訓練少男幫助他復仇,而少男亦替少北贏回..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shao Nan is proud of his brother Shao Bai being the combat fighting champion. When Shao Bei died after being seriously injured in a fight, the founder of the fight company decides to train Shao Nan for vengeance. Shao Nan eventually rises to become the next champion, fulfilling his brothers last wish and make Asians proud.

epg.programme_title_tc: 封神榜: 決戰萬仙陣
epg.programme_title_en: The First Myth Clash of Gods
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Shang dynasty, the deities of Tong Tian Cult are killed by the Zhou army led by Jiang Zi Ya. Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.programme_title_en: Seventeen and a Half Years Old
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張君佳是一名高中學生,為了接近校花黃巧姍,他想拍一部微電影,讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來,他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片,拍攝期間,眾人幾經波折,劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..

This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in ancient times, leader of the demon tribe, Chi You, causes chaos in heaven and is demoted to become a kind human. When Chi Yous evil power awakens years later, he find ways to break his seal in Kun Lun, where he meets a princess and fall in love. Through perilous trials, Chi You and the princess unravel the truth behind a conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海神探張一人奉命到太平鎮調查一樁離奇兇案。村民們都傳是女鬼冤魂作祟,張在調查的過程中也接二連三有人遇害,跟著紙人勾魂、怨靈作祟的說法也悄然傳開。最終,張在當地乞丐狗子協助下把兇手繩之以法。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1990年的東北,年輕氣盛的私營小巴司機徐鐵愛上了家境優渥的陳麗莎,因為現實差距,二人的關係遭到麗莎的母親反對。為了賺錢,徐鐵誤入歧途,導致了身邊人的犧牲。在家人和朋友的幫助下,徐鐵終浪子回頭,明白了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young minibus driver Xu Tie falls for a rich girl Lisa. However, Lisas mother disapproves of Xu due to their social differences. Xu Tie goes astray in the hope of earning more money, but ends up harming his friends. With the support of family and friends, Xu Tie tries to make amends and begins to appreciate love and life.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the oppressive rule of Emperor Heng, some volunteers sign on the Belt Oath to overthrow the government. The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觀山太保傳人張三爺應師弟赫老道之邀,與徒弟前往棺山找尋傳說中的麻姑墓。相傳內裡不僅有珍貴寶物,還有長生之術。他們為探尋真相去尋找古墓,而當古墓即將開啟時,軍閥羅蠻子突然出現。原來這是一個騙局,羅及赫是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Sanye joins his junior He Lao Dao on a quest to a fabled tomb said to hold treasures and the secrets of immortality. However, as the tomb is about to open, warlord Luo Man Zi suddenly appears, and it turns out to be a plot set up by both Luo and He for Zhang. A thrilling journey into the tomb has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 火鍋店在香港深受街坊歡迎,店少東從父親手中接棒經營後卻遇上特殊時期,生意受挫,但少東仍然咬緊牙關,不肯辭退員工,期望生活早日重歸正常。一天,匪徒把火鍋店變成挾持人質的犯罪現場,而員工,顧客及未婚妻生命..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While hotpot restaurants thrive in Hong Kong, a young man taking over his fathers hotpot business faces tough times ahead. He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以阿古力為首的狼衛軍攻打硫勒城,企圖得到竊天氏的龍脈寶藏和天下第一美人將軍史天驕。守城將軍史萬夫寡不敵眾,與好友肖不平密謀,利用《竊天書》設計反攻狼衛軍。史為了擊退狼衛軍,拯救自己的女兒和全城百姓,竟..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Yang Jian ventures to earth to find the stolen Lotus Lantern that safeguards the world. He falls in love with a mortal girl, and they team up to attack the demon king who threatens to subvert the six realms. In the end, the couple successfully safeguard the Lotus Lantern and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著用生命來維護世間陰陽平衡的陽冥司端木熙,與遭遇車禍意外死去的漫畫屋老闆楊敬華。楊陰差陽錯被迫與端簽訂終身契約,成為端的影靈,二人互相看不慣對方,卻被契約緊緊捆綁在一起。之後連續發生詭異的死亡..

Yang becomes a spirit attached to Duan through a lifetime contract.  Initially at odds, they unite to entangle the mysteries of recurring bizzare deaths and restore peace and harmony.

Guan meets the troubled Ye Fei again after he resolves a case involving innocent deaths in a brothel, and they team up to successfully fight against the demons and evil spirits with their wit and bravery.

A year later, she learns from the newsmonger Bao that the massacre was orchestrated by a bandit who wants to avenges his fathers death caused by Rus father. With the help of Bao, Ru vanquishes the lackeys of the bandit and seeks her own vengeance.

Warlord Xiao Ba Tin colludes with some bandits and force the poor to plant opium. Ah Xi steps up to fight against them and finally exterminate the evil gang.

Thousand years later, Artha breaks the seal and launches an attack to the east. The holy chevaliers unite with the martial arts cults to find the holy sword, hoping to seal Artha again and save the people from his tyrannical reign.

Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

As the son of the old triad boss seeks revenge for his fathers death, he accidentally makes friend with the new triad boss right-hand man. However, as the two are destined rivals, a fatal battle between them is inevitable!

He sets up a security services company with a computer expert and a skilful fighter, and their first job is to protect a dog. The job seems quite simple, but it turns out to be a perilous task as they unravel a conspiracy behind the mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

Inside the tomb, they encounter various difficulties and experience life and death. In the process, they also discover a mysterious treasure in the tomb and unveils their masters secret.

With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

His partner encourages Han to be his former self by escorting an actress to Southeast Asia to film a show. On the way, Han successfully deals with threats to the actress life, but realizes in the end that he is the one the evil gang has targeted!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Huang leads 800 warriors to rescue General Li and other generals trapped by the 100,000 Sha Men troops in Bai Po City. He successfully saved General Li after overcoming various dangers, and stalled Sha Men forces as they await troop reinforcements.  In the end, General Li and the 800 warriors heroically safeguard their homeland.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bomb squad leader Xu discovers a warehouse explosion in Binhai City resembling the “June 11” case six years ago, in which one suspect died and another accomplice, Gui, was jailed. On the day the warehouse explodes, Gui is released from prison and goes to claim the robbery booty from Diao. Who is the mastermind behind the bombing?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東漢末年亂世紛爭,少年趙子龍與同鄉夏侯蘭因為一場意外而捲入到這個亂世中來,但他們二人卻選擇了不同的人生道路。最終趙子龍戰勝了為一己之私而背叛初衷的夏侯蘭。趙持長劍於亂世行走,踏破黑暗掀起波瀾,最終選擇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Eastern Han Dynasty, young Zhao Zi Long and his comrade Xia Hou Lan accidentally get involved in the chaos, but they end up with different paths in life. Zhao Zi Long finally triumphs over the selfish Xia Hou Lan and fights against the dark forces, teaming up with Liu Bei and achieving victories for the Han dynasty in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南方一座城市中突發一起爆炸危機事件,排爆特警在第一時間展開迅速救援和周密偵破。為排除其他爆炸隱患,守護群眾安全,特警馬進和朱江等人衝鋒在前,不斷化解炸彈危機。排爆隊員在全城展開排爆行動與犯罪分子之間..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a sudden explosion in the city, the anti-explosion team dashes to the scene to rescue and investigate. Led by Officer Ma and Officer Zhu, they prioritize peoples safety and set out to prevent further explosions. Tension mounts as the situation becomes increasingly volatile. Can the team defeat the odds and bring an end to the crisis?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Jian, who rules China with the aid of sorcerer Hong Yi, is ill. His brother bribes Hong Yis confidant, Zhou Fang, in an attempt to seize the throne. Xiang Bai and Cai Ying fortuitously join Hong Yis club, and when Zhou Fang discovers the resemblance between Hong Yi and Cai Ying, she kidnaps Cai Ying in a conspiracy to fake Hong Yi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風暴安保公司猛虎小隊負責安保及營救工作。小隊接到新任務,受到國際和平基金會僱傭,護送一輛裝滿水源淨化器和大量農作物種子的卡車前往薩基亞村落進行民間救援。可當地遭遇無政府組織入侵,途經區域處於戰火地帶。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Tiger Team of Storm Security Company is assigned by the International Peace Foundation to escort a truck filled with water purifiers and planting seeds to Sakiya village. Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 錦毛鼠白玉堂因不滿展昭被賜禦貓封號,同結拜兄弟“陷空島五鼠在東京火神節上盜取火神像,以此羞辱負責巡防治安的展昭。不料二人在爭搶火神像時,祭祀大典和整個煙花坊突起水澆不滅的大火,無辜百姓被燒成灰燼。白..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Upset by Constable Zhangs prestigious title of Imperial Cat, Bai and his sworn brother steal a god statue during the Tokyo God of Fire Festival to embarass Zhang. Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Master of Da Huang City orchestrates demonic chaos on earth to revive Chi Hou, who was sealed by the Emperor three thousand years ago. After his martial arts training, Li Jing vows to vanquish the demons and uphold justice. Together with Jiang Zi Ya and team, he strives to save the people in a deadly battle against the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群年輕的大學生策劃了一場特殊的畢業旅行,然而卻陰差陽錯闖入了一座巨獸棲息的禁忌之島。因為人類的失誤,這個島成為了怪獸樂園,學生們要戰勝巨獸才能逃出生天。而隨著深入探索,他們發現這次畢業旅行背後,似乎..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of university students embarks on a graduation trip, but accidentally trespass into an forbidden island, which is the home of a giant monster. Due to humans fault, the island is now a monster paradise. The students must defeat the monster to escape and as they explore further, they uncover a hidden conspiracy behind the trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張宸是軍事戰術教官,經常輾轉於世界各地為安保公司做戰術培訓。一次意外中,張被捲入一宗謀殺案,成了當地的通緝犯。張被迫逃亡,並在同伴初五的幫助下找到了謀殺案倖存者黛米。三人相互配合,開始著手調查,在槍林..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在東北下鄉的知識青年胡八一等人為了救助患病的村民畫眉,聯合獵人趙叔前去森林雪人熊洞採集解藥。然而,一夥人突然遭到熊的攻擊,只好逃入黃鼠狼地下洞穴。他們目睹了那裡發生的奇怪事情和出現幻覺。胡等人破除迷信..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Hu Ba and hunter Zhao venture to a bear-guarded cave to find an antidote to cure a sick villager. Attacked by the bear, they take refuge in a weasels cave where they encounter bizarre incidents and illusions. After Hu and Zhao dispelled the superstition trap and uncovered the true culprit, they successfully escape and rescue the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Qi kills his brother and seizes the throne, causing chaos in the country. When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

Desert Bugs are mutated to cause human extinction and the last hope of the survivors is to find the oasis. A team made up of tycoons, scientists, security chiefs, engineers and gangsters embarks on a perilous journey in an armoured tank to find the oasis.

The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

In the process, he uncovers Hus involvement in a criminal case and encounters spooky incidents, as well as rumours of vengeful killing by hell guards. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

On the way, they encounter a mysterious sea monster as well as the pirates. Lin must join forces with the marine team to battle against them and accomplish their mission.

On the way, they encounter a mysterious sea monster as well as the pirates. Lin must join forces with the marine team to battle against them and accomplish their mission.

Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

When Zhang is released, he decides to quit the triad and take care of his daughter but accidentally kills the triad boss. Ta Lis brother, Cha, takes revenge by kidnapping Zhangs daughter, resulting in a deadly battle between the two men.

As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

However, there is a rumour that no one can leave the basement alive. Determined to save his wife and free the prisoners, Shen embarks on a dangerous journey through the citys labyrinth of mechanism.

They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agent Tang is trained by the secret society to work undercover in the imperial government. Tang wants to quit for a peaceful life with her husband but is forced to kill the Imperial Prince when the society holds her husband hostage. Tang resolves to break free and joins forces with the Imperial Prince to destroy the society and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Yuan and his crew explore the mysteries of outer space after the Space Centre detects extraterrestrial signals. However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Zhou Wu has defeated the Shang empire with General Yang defeating the Shang army. Military advisor Shen advises Emperor Shang to recruit Seven Monsters with mystic skills to attack Zhou, so Emperor Shang orders his general to find Seven Monsters in Mountain Mei. The battle between Zhou and Shang has just begun!

Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

When Huo escorts a revolutionary leader to the capital, he finally understands that the country and its people are the ultimate purpose for practising martial arts.

Zhao Zi Long finally triumphs over the selfish Xia Hou Lan and fights against the dark forces, teaming up with Liu Bei and achieving victories for the Han dynasty in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變.北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 於11月見證大自然一些最不可思議的事,從聚在墨西哥森林中的數百萬隻君主斑蝶,到籠罩著杜拜市的濃霧,標誌著冬天的開始.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexicos forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺.馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅.而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨阿曼達博士拯救一隻失明的寵物狒狒,並細看夏洛特博士幫一隻跟偷獵者發生衝突的穿山甲進行一場刁鑽的截肢手術.之後,追趕一頭被樹所困的犀牛,兩隻出走的小狒狒和一隻兇猛的巨蜥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tag along as Dr. Amanda rescues a blind pet baboon, and watch Dr. Charlottes tricky surgery on a pangolin whose leg must be amputated after a run-in with poachers. Later, chase a rhino, two young baboons gone AWOL, and a fiesty monitor lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾斯堤的腿部感染妨礙了這頭年輕的麂羚歸野,因而面臨一個艱難的決定.然後跟阿曼達博士一起追蹤並替一隻年輕獅子套上頸圈;檢查一隻生病的叢林嬰兒;迎接中心吵鬧的新成員- 一隻暴躁的灰鸚鵡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Face a tough decision when Estis leg infection puts the brakes on this young duikers release. Then track and collar a young lion with Dr. Amanda; check on an ailing bush baby; and greet the noisy new addition to the center, a grumpy grey parrot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一頭名叫美祖木的年輕雄性鬣狗的故事,圍繞生命中最具挑戰性的旅程- 找一個新家族.作為一名主導雌性的兒子,牠有一個被優待的童年,但當牠的地位在青春期時下降,因牠被母親放逐了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Mizumus status drops during adolescence, his alpha female mother disowns him. Follow his challenging journey to find a new clan while overcoming the threats of charging hippos, hungry crocodiles, a pack of wild dogs, and a hyena-eating leopard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的中心,有一個人跡罕至的偏遠地區.沒有人為干預,使這裡成為三百隻馳名的白唇西貒的棲息地.這些大型類豬哺乳類動物能長到四十五公斤,下巴下有白色條紋,因獨特外觀而得名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek through the forests and savannahs of the Pantanals Nhecolândia region, which is home to noisy herds of peccaries. Follow these pig-like mammals on their daily food-foraging routes, and run into roseate spoonbills and capybaras along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變.北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexicos forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​揭開沼澤地那詭異卻迷人的面紗:這些濕地數百年來激發了無數傳說與民間故事,同時成為連結生與死的重要橋樑.與飢餓的鱷魚一同潛泳,目睹梅花鹿為了覓食而賭上性命的瞬間,並觀察食肉植物迅速捕捉獵物的驚人畫面.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加是地球上任何其他地方都找不到的奇怪動物的家.當這些動物為權位而戰,牠們的戰鬥也很奇特--從象鼻蟲怪異的脖子摔角,到環尾狐猴母嬰間的打鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange - from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur moms that go into battle with baby on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨阿曼達博士拯救一隻失明的寵物狒狒,並細看夏洛特博士幫一隻跟偷獵者發生衝突的穿山甲進行一場刁鑽的截肢手術.之後,追趕一頭被樹所困的犀牛,兩隻出走的小狒狒和一隻兇猛的巨蜥.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家.一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心.馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食.在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與鱷魚爭奪河流的主導權,展開對支配權的激烈較量,然後一瞥極為罕見的紅樹林蛇,以及瀕臨絕種的納巴勒克小袋鼠.前往海洋,看見座頭鯨的母鯨撫育牠們的幼鯨,接著又遭到偽虎鯨的追逐與獵捕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個野狗家族生活在尚比亞盧安瓜谷的一角.雌性的巢內有幼崽,這是她和伴侶生養的最新一窩.許多年齡較大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠們幫助作保姆,並狩獵食物養活家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a close-knit family of wild dogs who work together to raise pups and hunt enough food to feed the whole pack. While their well-coordinated hunts are successful, the wet season brings challenges when some of the team strikes out on their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西的中心有著美洲最大的貓科動物- 驚豔的美洲虎,雄霸充滿自然美景和多樣性的神奇土地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Brazil, the largest cat in the Americas, the magnificent jaguar, reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨阿曼達博士拯救一隻失明的寵物狒狒,並細看夏洛特博士幫一隻跟偷獵者發生衝突的穿山甲進行一場刁鑽的截肢手術.之後,追趕一頭被樹所困的犀牛,兩隻出走的小狒狒和一隻兇猛的巨蜥.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Face a tough decision when Estis leg infection puts the brakes on this young duikers release. Then track and collar a young lion with Dr. Amanda; check on an ailing bush baby; and greet the noisy new addition to the center, a grumpy grey parrot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​讓時間凝結,見證水在地球最冰冷的生態系中,如何化為改變的力量.與北極熊一同獵捕毫無防備的海豹,與獼猴在天然的溫泉中沐浴取暖,並體驗北極狐那獨特而靈巧的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earths most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食.在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與鱷魚爭奪河流的主導權,展開對支配權的激烈較量,然後一瞥極為罕見的紅樹林蛇,以及瀕臨絕種的納巴勒克小袋鼠.前往海洋,看見座頭鯨的母鯨撫育牠們的幼鯨,接著又遭到偽虎鯨的追逐與獵捕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個野狗家族生活在尚比亞盧安瓜谷的一角.雌性的巢內有幼崽,這是她和伴侶生養的最新一窩.許多年齡較大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠們幫助作保姆,並狩獵食物養活家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a close-knit family of wild dogs who work together to raise pups and hunt enough food to feed the whole pack. While their well-coordinated hunts are successful, the wet season brings challenges when some of the team strikes out on their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西的中心有著美洲最大的貓科動物- 驚豔的美洲虎,雄霸充滿自然美景和多樣性的神奇土地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Brazil, the largest cat in the Americas, the magnificent jaguar, reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨阿曼達博士拯救一隻失明的寵物狒狒,並細看夏洛特博士幫一隻跟偷獵者發生衝突的穿山甲進行一場刁鑽的截肢手術.之後,追趕一頭被樹所困的犀牛,兩隻出走的小狒狒和一隻兇猛的巨蜥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tag along as Dr. Amanda rescues a blind pet baboon, and watch Dr. Charlottes tricky surgery on a pangolin whose leg must be amputated after a run-in with poachers. Later, chase a rhino, two young baboons gone AWOL, and a fiesty monitor lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭南島的頂部,你會發現一片兩極對立的土地,這裡是世界上最長的沙洲其中之一,吸引著斑尾塍鹬與飢餓的領航鯨,而淹沒的河谷為暗色斑紋海豚和新澳毛皮海獅提供了自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealands South Island, where one of the worlds longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家.一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心.馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾斯堤的腿部感染妨礙了這頭年輕的麂羚歸野,因而面臨一個艱難的決定.然後跟阿曼達博士一起追蹤並替一隻年輕獅子套上頸圈;檢查一隻生病的叢林嬰兒;迎接中心吵鬧的新成員- 一隻暴躁的灰鸚鵡.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳洲擁有各種別樹一幟的生物,成功成為王者的方式也同樣多樣性.海灘變成決鬥場,內陸成了拳擊場,動物們同室干戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a dueling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是令人難以置信關於一棵樹的故事,它已存活了八百多年...能抵受最惡劣的環境...而且昆蟲,鳥類和動物更喜歡它...巨大的猢猻樹.它紮根於津巴布韋南部的馬里蘭威禁獵區的大草原.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years... that can withstand the harshest conditions... and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other...the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加大狐猴indris是現存原猴類中體型最大的類群,他們每天在雨林中尋找食物和躲避捕食者.讓我們看看這些瀕臨滅絕的靈長類動物如何在迅速縮小的棲息地中克服一切困難生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the story of a day in the life of an Indris Family following a mother, father, and their three offspring around their home in the rainforest of Mantadia National Park in Madagascar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白眉長臂猿是印度叢林的專家.生活在親密的家庭中,少猴花費數年時間學習生存的技能.為你介紹沙馬,牠尋找食物,避開掠食者,並掌握於林木間生活所需的雜技.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hoolock Gibbons are specialists of the Jungle. Living in close knit families, youngsters spend years learning the skills to survive. Meet Samar as he forages for food, avoids predators, and masters the acrobatics required for a life in the trees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 印度東北部的草原是地球上最肥沃的棲息地之一,該處生長茂盛的野草,讓罕見的印度犀牛賴以維生,並茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The grasslands of Northeast India are one of the most fertile habitats on earth. Hundreds of species of tall grass flourish here, allowing one of Indias most iconic creatures to thrive... the Greater One-horned Rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拉達克高原是一片極端之地,但西藏野驢是這片草原的王者.跟隨一匹影響一群雌性的種馬,她有機會繁殖下一代,但若然如此,她必須與那些想要牠皇冠的對手作戰!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ladakh plateau is a land of extremes, but the Tibetan wild ass is the king of this grassland. Follow one stallion as he shadows a herd of females for his chance to sire the next generation, but in doing so, he must battle those wanting his crown!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在灼熱和充滿熱帶風暴的土地上,印度南部平原的生活十分艱苦.但一頭帶著兩隻幼崽的雌性樹懶比比,正迎接她生活上的挑戰,她每刻都要對抗缺水缺糧和掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a land of heat and tropical storms, life on the plains of southern India is tough. But Bibi, a female sloth bear with two cubs, is up for the challenge of her life as she fights against drought, food scarcity, and predators around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊.在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽. 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著名叫奧廉巴的莽撞雌豹,遊覽尚比亞盧安瓜谷的心臟地帶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the heart of Zambias Luangwa Valley, where shady woodlands and antelope-packed plains offer the perfect hunting grounds for an audacious female leopard named Olimba and the pack she must struggle to control.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奈士富獅群生活在尚比亞的盧安瓜河畔.見證經驗豐富的雌獅養育一群幼獅,還有牠們如何在惡劣環境中努力生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nsefu lion pride welcomes seven new cubs during the wet season, when antelope and buffalo are spread far from the river, making them harder to hunt. Learn how the mother lionesses work to keep the boisterous cubs alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭大雄獅,有著強大的兄弟情誼,統治了奈士富獅群三年,但三年是很長的統治期,其他競爭者逐步進逼.兩兄弟將要竭力保護家族和領導地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Twin brothers with a powerful bond have ruled the Nsefu pride for three years. Theyre fathers to all the young, and protectors of their territory. Witness the struggle that unfolds when rival males target their territory.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一頭名叫美祖木的年輕雄性鬣狗的故事,圍繞生命中最具挑戰性的旅程- 找一個新家族.作為一名主導雌性的兒子,牠有一個被優待的童年,但當牠的地位在青春期時下降,因牠被母親放逐了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Mizumus status drops during adolescence, his alpha female mother disowns him. Follow his challenging journey to find a new clan while overcoming the threats of charging hippos, hungry crocodiles, a pack of wild dogs, and a hyena-eating leopard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個野狗家族生活在尚比亞盧安瓜谷的一角.雌性的巢內有幼崽,這是她和伴侶生養的最新一窩.許多年齡較大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠們幫助作保姆,並狩獵食物養活家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a close-knit family of wild dogs who work together to raise pups and hunt enough food to feed the whole pack. While their well-coordinated hunts are successful, the wet season brings challenges when some of the team strikes out on their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一隻水獺如何融入家中,成為大家庭的一份子;與鵝寶寶貢博一起觀賞河邊景色,並探望一隻不幸失明的刺蝟和他的人類知心友.見證一位泳手與野生灰海豹在水中共舞,並與猴子和藪貓一起度過歡樂時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embrace an invasive nutria whos become part of the family, paddle around with Gumbo the goose, and visit a blind hedgehog and his human chum. Explore a swimmers bond with wild gray seals and hang out with Cosima the monkey and Jasper the serval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略.參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探望忙於幫助鯊魚保持牙齒閃爍的海上牙醫,傾聽海豚家族的獨特叫聲.發掘卷尾猴的開果實工具,並分享長頸鹿相互偎依所帶來的溫暖,最後與一位流氓狐獴相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一隻水獺如何融入家中,成為大家庭的一份子;與鵝寶寶貢博一起觀賞河邊景色,並探望一隻不幸失明的刺蝟和他的人類知心友.見證一位泳手與野生灰海豹在水中共舞,並與猴子和藪貓一起度過歡樂時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embrace an invasive nutria whos become part of the family, paddle around with Gumbo the goose, and visit a blind hedgehog and his human chum. Explore a swimmers bond with wild gray seals and hang out with Cosima the monkey and Jasper the serval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略.參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探望忙於幫助鯊魚保持牙齒閃爍的海上牙醫,傾聽海豚家族的獨特叫聲.發掘卷尾猴的開果實工具,並分享長頸鹿相互偎依所帶來的溫暖,最後與一位流氓狐獴相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲大草原有著史詩式的景致,無論是砸頭的河馬,荷爾蒙失調的大象還是決鬥的獅子,席捲大草原的戰鬥都同樣是史詩式的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The African savanna is an epic landscape, and whether its head-bashing hippos, hormone-crazed elephants or dueling lions, battles that rage on the savanna are just as epic.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族,好戰的沙漠族,紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow four families of four different species - the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band - to find out why these primates are among the most successful animals in Africa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊覽馬達加斯加高聳的山脈,茂密的熱帶雨林,樹木繁茂的沿海平原和乾燥的沙漠.看看侏羅紀時代的植物,古老的青蛙和爬行動物物種,以及新的漂流者是如何在這些奇特而美麗的風景中進化的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This film travels around the island visiting some of its most striking landscapes to explore how Madagascars species have evolved over time. Madagascar is a strangely beautiful and unique world with a staggering array of habitats and special land...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加有近400種爬行動物,約佔世界冷血動物的一半.觀看變色龍,蛇和300多種五顏六色的青蛙在島上的極端氣候中茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the lives of Madagascars cold-blooded creatures. Chameleons, frog, lizards, and snakes have all adapted in order to survive on the island. We take a look at how they find food, reproduce, and avoid predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五月的每天,太陽如常升起.從漢波德企鵝到哥倫比亞雨林的猴子,再到太平洋邊緣的科隆群島奇異美洲鬣蜥,美洲熱帶地區的動物已經準備好抵抗酷熱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow penguins, iguanas, tortoises, frogs and tamarins from Mexico to Peru, and as far west as the Galapagos Islands, as they live out their daily dramas, affected by the suns heat, looming predators and hazardous weather conditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏至影響亞洲動物,令越南獼猴進入涼快的水中,使鶴在寒冷的青藏高原上跳舞,並激發一種奇怪的魚出來散步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how creatures from the Tibetan plateau, to the lush rainforests of Thailand, to Vietnams twisted mangroves, survive four extra hours of daylight once a year, searching for food, fighting for dominance and raising their families.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭的聖誕節只是夏天裡的一天.雖然標誌性的鷸鴕躲避陽光,但海豹,黃眼企鵝和海豚卻享受長時間日照下充裕的額外餵食時間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how one animal familys tragedy is anothers holiday dinner as New Zealands mainland and island creatures, including penguins, flightless birds, sea lions, and sharks, battle to feed and protect their young in this marine environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 印度次大陸的母親節象徵旱季於斯里蘭卡開始,同時於印度結束.對於一隻孟加拉虎媽媽來說,是時候訓練她的幼崽去狩獵了,而獅子和眼鏡蛇則忙於交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find out which creatures survive and whose luck will run out as animal mothers and moms-to-be struggle with sweltering temperatures, lurking predators, mating season, and drought on a day that proves to be no holiday.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加州的海灘是世上最美麗的海灘之一,但由於人類對大自然的影響,它們是否會失去平衡?太平洋海岸壯麗的動物群如何在海灘生命線上繼續生活?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but are they falling out of balance due to mankinds effects on nature? What does it take for the magnificent fauna of the Pacific Coast to keep living... on the living beach?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾的南部邊界,有著世上獨一無二最大的熱帶濕地,野生動植物的多樣性使科學家們爭相瞭解動物的各種互動方式.博多克納山的高地是隱密的潘塔納爾濕地的入口.那裡的水十分清澈,因由超過6億年歷史的石灰岩所形成過濾層,為這些溪流中的生命提供了一個清晰的門戶. 瀑布,凝灰岩水壩,洞穴和純淨的河流,能見...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the southern edge of the Pantanal, where brown capuchin monkeys live in their own Garden of Eden. Dry season in the highlands treats them well until a drought dries up their food sources. Can an industrious agouti save them from starvation?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘塔納爾的南部濕地於每年都成為鳥類天堂,超過650種珍稀和標誌性的鳥類在繁殖季節中聚集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, the southern wetlands of the Pantanal become a bird paradise as over 650 species of rare and iconic birds congregate here for the breeding season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的中心,有一個人跡罕至的偏遠地區.沒有人為干預,使這裡成為三百隻馳名的白唇西貒的棲息地.這些大型類豬哺乳類動物能長到四十五公斤,下巴下有白色條紋,因獨特外觀而得名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek through the forests and savannahs of the Pantanals Nhecolândia region, which is home to noisy herds of peccaries. Follow these pig-like mammals on their daily food-foraging routes, and run into roseate spoonbills and capybaras along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西的中心有著美洲最大的貓科動物- 驚豔的美洲虎,雄霸充滿自然美景和多樣性的神奇土地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Brazil, the largest cat in the Americas, the magnificent jaguar, reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中.牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys whove been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔.遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象.見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎來到印度- 充滿異國的動物和異國的戰事.猴子打得塵土飛揚,印度黑羚在開闊的平原上全面開戰,孔雀哥兒開屏比拼:這些多姿多彩的戰鬥襯得上充滿活力的土地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome to India – a land of exotic animals and exotic warfare. Monkeys stage dusty dust-ups, blackbucks wage open war on the open plains, and peacock dandies swing switchblades: these are colorful battles worthy of a vibrant land.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在地球上最大,保存最完整的稀樹草原之中;在那裡,哺乳動物和昆蟲都能毫不費力地飛掠空中.了解傳統的野火管理方法,探索一處砂岩避難地,並看著一隻蜜袋鼯試著逃離火焰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心.最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在鬣狗家族中有一個新面孔. 斑斑註定要成為位於尚比亞盧安瓜谷心臟地帶斑鬣狗族群的首領.她自出生起已有崇高身份,但她仍然需要證明自己.族群是一個危險的地方,她必須為自己打出一席位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spotty, a female hyena cub, is destined to be leader of the Chimbwe clan that lives in the heart of Zambias Luangwa Valley. But she has yet to prove herself. Witness her fight to find her place in this savagely competitive family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 脆弱又難以捉摸的豹貓在許多國家都屬於瀕危物種.但在世上最大的熱帶濕地之一的潘塔納爾濕地的南部邊界,這種驚豔的野貓似乎打算捲土重來.一群年輕的野生動物科學家正試圖瞭解原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join a group of wildlife scientists tracking the comeback of the ocelot in the Pantanal. Check in on their network of trail cameras, which capture the movements of this elusive spotted cat, and see the perils it faces, including giant anacondas.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往世界各地的海岸線,那裡的食物和棲息地衝突導致了絕望的生存之戰.目睹企鹅們從愉悅的性情轉變為兇殘的憤怒,進入一頭保護幼崽的座頭鯨的世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Massive elephant seals go nose to nose to win the title of beachmaster, and giant petrels earn the nickname, murderous garbagemen. Meanwhile, a female humpback goes to extremes to protect her calf from amorous males.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心.最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的塞德堡山脈是一片多年來由風,水和火雕琢而成的奇石地貌.這些壯觀的山峰是眾多不同植物和動物的家.但這裡亦有些看不見的東西,墊伏在陰暗處伺機攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rocky landscape, carved over eons by wind, water and fire, these are the Cederberg Mountains of South Africa. These imposing peaks are home to an incredible diversity of plants and animals. But there are some here that remain unseen, lurking in ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們將帶領您環繞著赤道,深入探索居住在熱帶森林中的多樣物種,您將有機會遇見一隻獨自打造迷你森林的樹懶,與共享互助的狐猴,以及細心照料林地花園的象群,隨後,我們將一同揭開熱帶森林的神秘面紗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西亞馬遜熱帶雨林南部邊界的一片受保護森林中,居住著新世界最聰明和最敏捷的猴子之一 - 亞馬遜蛛猴.長尾巴就如牠們的第五個肢體,牠們很少離開森林的樹梢而走到地面.牠們是森林的「大使」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get an inside look at the Pantanals most extraordinary primate families. Check out the ear-splitting cries of howler monkeys, the fearless leaps of curious saki monkeys, and the agile tails of highly intelligent white-whiskered spider monkeys.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們將帶領您環繞著赤道,深入探索居住在熱帶森林中的多樣物種,您將有機會遇見一隻獨自打造迷你森林的樹懶,與共享互助的狐猴,以及細心照料林地花園的象群,隨後,我們將一同揭開熱帶森林的神秘面紗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西亞馬遜熱帶雨林南部邊界的一片受保護森林中,居住著新世界最聰明和最敏捷的猴子之一 - 亞馬遜蛛猴.長尾巴就如牠們的第五個肢體,牠們很少離開森林的樹梢而走到地面.牠們是森林的「大使」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get an inside look at the Pantanals most extraordinary primate families. Check out the ear-splitting cries of howler monkeys, the fearless leaps of curious saki monkeys, and the agile tails of highly intelligent white-whiskered spider monkeys.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心.最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在納米比亞中部,一群非洲野犬在乾旱的土地上漫遊.受到獅子和乾旱兩面夾擊,一隻名為賴卡的勇敢幼崽必須快速成長,學習獵人的技能,並找到自己在族群中的定位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In central Namibia, a pack of painted wolves roams the arid land. Amid threats from lions and drought, a plucky little pup called Lyca has to grow up fast, learn the skills of a hunter, and find her place as member of the pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的夏季短捉,時間緊迫- 任何時候都是戰鬥的好時機.宏大的北方為野牛,禿鷹和北極熊提供了動物王國中激戰的戰場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Canada, where summer is short and time is tight – any time is the right time to fight. The mighty North provides the setting for bison, bald eagles, and polar bears to wage some of the most heavy-duty fighting in the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷有一片烏木樹林,是一群狒狒的家園.但這裡存在著危險 - 與其他掠食者不同,同為居民的獵豹具有足夠的強大和敏捷性來爬樹.牠不是容易逃避的敵人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Luangwa Valley lies a grove of Ebony trees, home to a troop of baboons. But, there are dangers here – the resident leopard who, unlike the other predators, is powerful and agile enough to climb trees. Hes not an easy foe to elude.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧安瓜谷的平原和林地住著最狂野和最無情的動物,捕食者和獵物間的對決日以繼夜進行著.對於稱它為家的動物來說,每天都要靠戰鬥生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The plains and woodlands of the Luangwa Valley are the wildest and most merciless of all neighborhoods where duels between predator and prey are played out both day and night. For the animals that call this home, its a daily battle to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同欣賞四季更迭,並深入了解樹木和動物如何相互依賴共生.在夜幕低垂之際,欣賞在春天夜晚翩翩起舞的螢火蟲,探索協助樹木降溫的夏季菌菇,並在秋葉紛飛之際為秋季的來臨做好準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的北部邊緣,地球上最大的熱帶濕地之一,有一個小池塘,是一個罕有的囓齒類動物的家園.牠們不是典型的老鼠或松鼠 - 這些巨鼠的大小與綿羊相若!在乾燥季節的中期,這個群體有數十個嬰兒需要養育並接受保護.挑戰就如牠們的身型一樣大,這些溫和的巨人在許多捕食者的菜單上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the northern edge of the Pantanal, in one of the largest tropical wetlands on Earth, is a small pond that is home to an unusual family of rodents. They are not your typical rats or squirrels - these giants are the size of sheep!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.
